lessons.title: People and introductions
lessons.note: Start with words for yourself, family, friends, and people around you. Japanese often leaves out a subject when the context makes it clear.

lessons.title: Places
lessons.note: These are places you may talk about in everyday life. The words are shown in kana; kanji forms can wait until you have learned them.

lessons.title: Food and everyday things
lessons.note: Learn a few familiar things to eat, drink, and read. ごはん can mean cooked rice or a meal, depending on the context.

lessons.title: Everyday actions
lessons.note: These verbs are shown in their dictionary form, the form used to look them up. Each one ends in る or む here.

lessons.title: Time and descriptions
lessons.note: Finish this set with words for days, parts of the day, and simple descriptions.
